About me

I’m an aspiring mechanical design engineer who enjoys turning an idea into a clean, buildable CAD model. My work spans product design, robotics and automation, structural layout and assembly design.

Each project here goes from concept to a full assembly, with exploded views and orthographic drawings that explain how the parts fit together.

I’m looking for internships and entry-level roles where I can contribute to mechanical design and product development.

Featured engineering projects

Click any image to view it larger.

Regenerative Drone, CAD Assembly

Multirotor drone | Assembly + drawings

A mechanical design of a multirotor drone assembly: structural arms, motor mounts, landing gear and integrated components, documented with exploded views and engineering drawings.

  • CAD assembly modeling
  • Mechanical component design
  • Structural design
  • Exploded-view documentation
  • Engineering drawing development

Agricultural Spraying Drone

Hexacopter | Agricultural application

A six-rotor drone designed for crop spraying: a hexagonal central plate, six motor arms and a payload tank slung beneath the frame, supported on a landing gear. Shown in top, isometric, side and front views.

  • Hexacopter frame design
  • Motor arm and mount layout
  • Payload tank integration
  • Landing gear design
  • Multi-view CAD documentation

Six-Axis Industrial Robotic Arm

Robotics | CAD assembly

A six-axis industrial arm modeled in CATIA, with a gripper end-effector, wrist motor and base, documented in dimensioned front and top views. It explores how joints, links and a wrist combine to give a wide, flexible workspace for pick-and-place and assembly tasks.

  • Robotic joint architecture
  • Multi-axis movement
  • Mechanical link design
  • CAD assembly development
  • Industrial automation applications
CAD design project. Not presented as a manufactured or tested robot.

Telescopic First Aid Stretcher

Product design | Patient transport

A design concept for a telescopic stretcher with an adjustable-height frame, wheeled mobility and a foldable patient platform, shown in multiple CAD views and iterations.

  • CAD modeling
  • Telescopic mechanism design
  • Structural assembly
  • Mobility and ergonomics
  • Mechanical product development

Scissor Lift Table

Lifting mechanism | Mobile platform

A mobile lifting platform that raises a table using a scissor mechanism, with a wheeled base and push handles.

  • Scissor linkage mechanism
  • Mechanical assembly modeling
  • Lifting platform design
  • Structural frame development
  • Mechanical motion principles

Space Capsule, Aerospace Mechanical Design

Aerospace | Conceptual design

A conceptual lander-style capsule with a structural enclosure, landing legs, a ramp, a dome and an internal rover bay, modeled as a complete CAD assembly.

  • Structural enclosure design
  • Component layout
  • CAD assembly development
Conceptual design only, not certified or flown.
